The structure of DyMn3O4 crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 143), with a unit cell containing 32 atoms—Dy4Mn12O16—and six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Mn centers as octahedral, each coordinated by six O neighbors, while Dy centers show six O neighbors and O centers show five neighbors (one Dy and four Mn). The connectivity forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 32 sites. Polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals corner- and edge-sharing between Mn octahedra, with Dy–Mn polyhedra sharing corners and edges.
